d:
I finally gave in to curiosity and paid for a Patreon subscription, so I hope you really appreciate what I’ll be posting over the next few days. It would be amazing if there were a way for you all to chip in so we could keep paying the artist and I could share the content with you. Just think about it: if 16 of us pooled our resources, we could see something that costs $8 for just $0.50 each. Just a thought.

A Spanish adaptation of the entire set is coming very soon.

Por fin cedi ante la curiosidad de pagar una suscri de patreon, asi que espero valoren mucho lo q subire los prox dias. Si hubiese una manera q puedan donar algo como para juntar y seguir pagandole al artista para yo poder compartirles estaria fenomenal. Solo piensenlo: Si entre 16 juntamos podriamos ver por 0.5 dolares algo q cuesta 8. Solo es una idea.

adaptacion de todo el set al español muy pronto
